objective: Record the exact Opus V complexity validator and Complexity Model Gap Atlas package bytes in append-only quarantine and route them to native-fit review without installing a parallel complexity engine or promoting any formula or scientific claim.
summary: Two new authenticated ChatGPT downloads were copied byte-for-byte into incoming_review. The 53,948-byte Opus V package is a self-consistent 24-test desk architecture validator with no formula file and all empirical/release authority withheld. The 104,844-byte Model Gap Atlas is a desk/computational roadmap with 16 overlays, 26 artistic-model concepts, zero formula mutations, zero physical results, and a nested XLSX child. Native archive scans are terminal with promotion false. Existing P2.2 and construction-complexity/C10/P3 contracts require field-level reuse analysis before any code decision.

decisions.decision: Map the Atlas first-wave controlled arms through native C10/P3 and keep the remaining overlays as candidate configuration or research backlog.
decisions.reason: The package itself reports the missing layer as causal isolation and physical evidence; it supplies no formula mutation or observations that prove a new canonical schema.
